QuestInfo.name: The Mind of a Zenumist
QuestInfo.0: Go find #bCarson#k, the head of the Zenumist Society, in the large building on the left side of Magatia.
QuestInfo.1: Go find #bCarson#k, the head of the Zenumist Society, in the large building on the left side of Magatia.
QuestInfo.2: Carson, the head of the Zenumist Society, avoided your questions on the forbidden research, but started to talk after seeing the #t4033649#. The research was hidden in Magatia for many years, because it was known to be the work of the #bBlack Mage#k, but now, that research has been stolen... and Carson believes the Alcadno Society is behind it.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 70,000
Can proceed to The Heart of an Alcadno

0.0: What do you want? This is Zenumist property. We do not allow the public here.\r\n#L0##b#p2300004# sent me here. I need you to tell me about the alchemy that creates life.#l\n#k
0.1: That knowledge is forbidden! Flashing #p2300004#'s name is not going to grant you access. I will need to see #bproof#k of your relationship to her.

yes.0: This could be a forgery... a trick...

no.0: Present the proof, or leave. Those are your options.

1.0: #p2300004#... I was sure she gone for good. I certainly did not expect her to send a strange child like you to be her messenger.

yes.0: I will share our secrets with you, but ONLY because\r\n#p2300004# asked me to do so. If you cross the Zenumists\r\nin any way, we will punish you accordingly, no matter what kind of friends you may have.
yes.1: This forbidden alchemy has haunted me since I discovered it long ago. I believed then that this knowledge was left behind by the #bBlack Mage#k. I knew it\r\nwas too dangerous for the world to know about.
yes.2: Unfortunately, it appears another group held the same beliefs. All books and scrolls regarding the research has been stolen. \r\n#bStolen?!#k
yes.3: Yes, and I don't know by who. However, the research was extremely well-hidden. It would have taken someone familiar with the inner-workings of our organization to find it.
yes.4: The #bAlcadno#k scum are vehemently denying their involvement, of course, but it must be them. They have no respect for the power of alchemy. It's quite obvious, wouldn't you agree?
